basis: The y-axis is inverted (0.0 at the top, 2.5 at the bottom), so a downward visual movement on the chart corresponds to an increase in the numerical value of 'physicians per 1,000 inhabitants'. The series shows a consistent downward trend from 2000 to 2017.5, ending at the lowest vertical position on the chart (approx 2.4). This indicates that the physician capacity per 1,000 inhabitants has increased over the reporting period, reaching its highest level at the end of the period. The task asks to route based on the 'observed end-of-period capacity pattern'. An increasing trend culminating in a higher capacity level fits the description of 'capacity expansion' rather than 'shortage' (which would imply a decline or low level). Therefore, the 'physician capacity expansion review pathway' is the most appropriate route.
option_label: Route to the physician capacity expansion review pathway
